source: synthetic GeM bid for security services (evals/golden/in/gem_security_services)

requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 1,20,00,000 during the last three financial years.
The bidder shall deposit an EMD of Rs. 5,00,000 online before the bid end date and time.
The bidder shall have at least 5 years of experience providing security manpower to public sector undertakings.
MSEs and recognised startups are exempted from the EMD on submission of the relevant certificate.
The bidder shall hold a valid licence under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 for Tamil Nadu.
2.1 The agency shall deploy 64 trained security personnel across four warehouses on three shifts every day.
2.2 The agency shall pay wages not less than the minimum wages notified for the state and produce proof by the 7th of each month.
2.3 The agency must deposit EPF and ESI contributions for every deployed person and furnish the monthly challans.
2.4 The agency shall replace an absent guard within two hours of the reported absence.
2.5 The agency should provide an electronic attendance system with biometric verification at each gate.
Scanned documents shall be legible and uploaded as a single PDF per requirement.
Bids shall be submitted online on the GeM portal before 03:00 PM IST on 02-12-2026.
All uploaded documents shall be digitally signed with a Class 3 DSC in the name of the authorised signatory.
The bidder shall upload the PSARA licence, the PAN card and the GST registration certificate.
Evaluation will follow the lowest total monthly cost among bidders meeting the eligibility criteria.
The buyer will verify statutory compliance records for the last two years before award.
